_doc: How a Thousandvale-only class (the Starcaller, wrap-up Y32; the Star Blade, round 11) cuts its WORN cloth/armour. Its tier-1 and tier-2 OUTFITS used to live here as well (`classes`, `tier2`); on 2026-10-22 they moved into the shared tables avatar-3d/data/class-outfits.json and class-outfits-t2.json (the t2 rows in tools/build-class-outfits-t2.mjs LITERAL) so the Avatar 3D / Armory galleries show all 32 classes — read them from there, there is one copy. `wear` stays Thousandvale's own: in the world a character wears exactly its gear (gear-look.js), and `wear[cls].cloth` says how THIS class's plain cloth pieces are cut and coloured (part by part: head -> hat, chest -> top, legs -> bottom, feet -> shoes) so a Starcaller in its starter robes is midnight and gold rather than the grey every cloth robe is. The worn head piece is a HOOD (the item is called a Hood, and a thing must look like its name — W25); the pointed hat is the portrait's. Only cloth pieces change, and only for that class; an item with its own model (item.look.worn) keeps it. Every part id is one the shared avatar-2d normaliser knows; `emblem` is a chibi2-armour2.js emblem (the star). ROUND 11 (owner #53): the Star Blade — night-blue plate with star-steel (silver) edges and the Starcaller's gold star on chest, back and helm brow; a dark cape and silver pauldrons. Its `wear` is cut for PLATE (`heavy`) and MAIL (`medium`), the weights it starts in: `wear[cls][<weight>]` (star-looks.js classWearLook reads any weight; the Starcaller's `cloth` is unchanged). Model ids follow the base's own name (a War Helm is the war helm, a Chain Shirt chainmail — W25).
